title: fix: send empty object instead of null for bedrock tool input
body:
When a tool call has no arguments, `call.arguments` is `None`, which gets converted to `Value::Null` via `Value::from()` and then to `Document::Null` via `to_bedrock_json`. The Bedrock Converse API rejects this:

```
ValidationException: The value at messages.1.content.0.toolUse.input is empty.
```

This mainly surfaces when resuming sessions across providers — `tool_result_serde` maps `Value::Null` arguments to `None`, and the Bedrock formatter doesn't handle that case.

The fix adds a small helper (`args_to_value`) that falls back to an empty object (`{}`) for `None` arguments, which is what Bedrock returns for no-argument tool calls anyway.

Closes #8050

`ToolHandler.reset()` merges every configured variable into the environment it hands to `SWEEnv`, using `os.getenv()`:

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix

- [ ] Refactor / code improvement

### What does this PR do?

`Locale.duration` formats sub-minute durations with `toFixed(1)`, which rounds, so 59,950 to 59,999 ms render as `60.0s`.
